seo.description: Cupping uses gentle suction to ease muscle tension and support circulation, often paired with massage.

articleHero.headline: What Are the Benefits of Cupping?
articleHero.directAnswer: Cupping uses gentle suction to help ease muscle tension and support circulation. Many people find it a relaxing complement to massage. It can leave temporary circular marks that usually fade within a few days.

richText.body:
## What cupping feels like
Warm or suction cups are placed on the skin to create a gentle pulling sensation that many find deeply relaxing.

## When people choose it
Cupping is often added to a massage for areas of stubborn tightness, especially the back and shoulders.

## Good to know
The temporary circular marks are normal and usually fade within a few days. If you have any medical concerns, check with your doctor first.
